Let the numbers be \(n,n+1,\dots,n+20\). Their total sum is

\[
21(n+10).
\]

If \(x\) is erased, then

\[
21(n+10)-x=2017
\]

so

\[
x=21n+210-2017=21n-1807.
\]

Since \(x\) is one of the listed numbers, \(n \le x \le n+20\):

\[
n \le 21n-1807 \le n+20.
\]

From \(n \le 21n-1807\),

\[
20n \ge 1807 \Rightarrow n \ge 91.
\]

From \(21n-1807 \le n+20\),

\[
20n \le 1827 \Rightarrow n \le 91.
\]

Thus \(n=91\), and

\[
x=21(91)-1807=1911-1807=104.
\]

\[
\boxed{104}
\]
